question: When was the Muslim League founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1906.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **All-India Muslim League** was a political party established in **1906** in British India. 
 
• The All-India Muslim League is popularly called the **Muslim League.** 
 
• It was founded by **Nawab Khwaja Salimullah** on 30 December 1906 at Dacca, British India (now Dhaka, Bangladesh)
 
• The party was primarily formed due to the need for the political representation of Muslims in British India.
